description: This file defines the 'statusCommand' function for the OpenClaw project, which generates a comprehensive status report including system health, sessions, plugins, security audit, and other diagnostics. It imports various modules for runtime, status, update channels, and more, and contains logic for loading modules dynamically, processing status data, and rendering detailed output.
